Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human sodium channel protein type 9 subunit alpha (CHEMBL4296). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to enforce presence of canonical SMILES. Join docs on doc_id to require at least one PubMed ID or DOI. Join compound_records on record_id to retrieve compound_key. Filter by target CHEMBL4296, standard_type IC50, and require canonical_smiles, pubmed_id, or doi to be non-null. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
